title: Reconstructing the processed restriction from its auxiliary data
statement: Let $t$ be a term on $n$ variables (a list of literals), let $\mathit{lits}$ be a list of literals each paired with a position index, let a decision-tree path be given, and let $\rho_0$, $\sigma$, and $\rho_{0,\mathrm{dec}}$ be restrictions on the $n$ variables. Assume that every literal in $\mathit{lits}$ has its variable left free by $\rho_0$, that every pair in $\mathit{lits}$ occurs in the indexed enumeration of $t$ (each literal of $t$ paired with its position), and that $\rho_{0,\mathrm{dec}}$ agrees with $\rho_0$ at every variable that $\rho_0$ fixes. Write $\rho_0^{\ast}$ for the restriction and $A$ for the auxiliary list of index–direction pairs produced by processing $\mathit{lits}$ against the path starting from $\rho_0$ and $\sigma$. Reconstruct a restriction from $\rho_{0,\mathrm{dec}}$ by folding over $A$: for each pair $(i,b)$, if deleting the first $i$ literals of $t$ leaves a nonempty list, set the variable of that list's head literal to $b$, and otherwise leave the restriction unchanged. Then at every variable $v$ at which $\rho_0^{\ast}$ is defined, this reconstructed restriction and $\rho_0^{\ast}$ take the same value.
hypotheses_covered: every literal in lits has its variable free under ρ₀
every pair in lits occurs in the indexed enumeration of t_clause
ρ₀_dec agrees with ρ₀ at every variable ρ₀ fixes

replaced:
Under the freeness and membership hypotheses on $\mathit{lits}$ and the agreement of
$\rho_{0,\mathrm{dec}}$ with $\rho_0$ on variables set by $\rho_0$, the $\rho_0$-fold over
the aux entries (which sets $l.\mathrm{var}$ to $e.2$ for each dropped head literal $l$)
applied to $\rho_{0,\mathrm{dec}}$ agrees with the processed restriction
$(\mathrm{processClauseLits}\ \mathit{lits}\ \mathit{path}\ \rho_0\ \sigma).2.1$ at every
variable $v$ where that restriction is set.
